name: Adansonia digitata extract
description: Adansonia digitata extract (CAS 91745-12-9 ), derived from the baobab tree, is sourced commercially for its concentrated nutrient and antioxidant profile. Known in trade as baobab extract, it functions as a humectant and antioxidant active across cosmetic, food, and nutraceutical formulations. In personal care, baobab extract is incorporated into skin creams, serums, and hair conditioners where its moisture-retention properties support hydration claims and product stability. Food and beverage manufacturers use it as a functional ingredient in energy drinks and protein bars. By leveraging its natural vitamin C and amino acid content, it is ideal for fortified powders. Nutraceutical formulators incorporate it into dietary supplement capsules and blends targeting antioxidant and nutritional positioning for various health-conscious consumer markets. Pharmaceutical and wellness product developers also use it as a natural excipient or active botanical in health-oriented formulations. This versatile extract provides a robust profile of bioactive compounds suitable for high-performance product development. Adansonia digitata extract is supplied primarily as a fine powder, with spray-dried forms being standard for food and supplement applications. Liquid and standardized extract concentrates are available for cosmetic manufacturing to ensure ease of integration. Grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications, with some suppliers offering organic-certified material to meet clean-label requirements.
